Name: Malini Balakrishnan
Bio:
Prof Malini Balakrishnan currently serves as the Director, Center for Water Security and a Professor at Plaksha University. Prior to joining Plaksha, she was a Senior Fellow at The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), New Delhi, where she spent over 25 years working closely with different industry sectors to improve resource use, resource recovery, and waste utilization. Her work on enhancing resource efficiency in small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across multiple sectors, including metal fabrication and finishing, and the manufacture of chemicals and intermediates, in India and select South Asian countries has resulted in significant savings in energy, water, and raw materials.

Prof Balakrishnan's experience spans the execution and coordination of pilot demonstrations of technologies such as membrane filtration (for upgrading the juice clarification process in the Indian sugar industry), diffusion dialysis, acid retardation, nanofiltration-based recovery systems (for waste acid and rinse water in Indian metal-finishing SMEs), and membrane bioreactors for sewage treatment.
Education: PhD, IIT Delhi | MASc, Chemical Engineering, University of Waterloo, Canada | MSc Hons, Chemistry, BITS Pilani | BE Hons, Chemical Engineering, BITS Pilani
Research_Summary:
Prof Balakrishnan's research efforts have been primarily targeted at evolving affordable solutions to specific local problems. She initiated and led TERI's efforts in field testing of membrane bioreactors (MBRs) for wastewater treatment using indigenously prepared membranes from industrial waste. Her experience in various pilot demonstrations have provided a deeper understanding of challenges in technology adaptation and possible approaches that would encourage the uptake of such technologies.

Furthermore, she has worked extensively in partnership with various international and national research groups, leading several multi-institutional international projects. Many of these projects were funded by the European Commission, with TERI as the lead partner. Overall, Prof Balakrishnan has successfully integrated applied R&D with academic research.
Research_Interests: Wastewater treatment | Membrane technologies | Resource recovery | Translating technology solutions | Circular economy | Wastewater | Resource Efficiency
Publications_Sample: As an adjunct faculty at the TERI School of Advanced Studies, Prof Balakrishnan has supervised PhD candidates and published over 100 research papers (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=LGcvSiEAAAAJ&hl=en). She has served as a nominated expert in select programmes of the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, in the Chemical Division Council of Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), and as a reviewer for various funding agencies and peer-reviewed international journals.
